The amplification factor is the ratio of the original query size to the final response size.

To implement it, you typically use a recursive resolver like `dig` or `nslookup` with a `-A` flag to specify the target name. • Application-level protections: Use connection pooling and connection-oriented protocols like HTTP/2 to reduce the number of active connections.
• Rate-limiting: Implement server-side rate limiting to prevent brute-force attacks.
